questions.q: Why does this lesson say the Application Architect exam tests the combination of its four prerequisites rather than re-testing them individually?
options: Because the prerequisites are irrelevant to the actual exam content
Because Salesforce removed the prerequisite requirement for this credential

Because the exam's scenario questions assume candidates already have the prerequisite foundation (data modeling, sharing/visibility, app building, development) and tests whether they can combine those skills into one coherent application design
Because the prerequisites only matter for the Technical Architect credential, not Application Architect
questions.explain: The lesson explains that Application Architect scenarios assume the prerequisite foundation (Platform App Builder, Platform Developer I, Data Architect, Sharing and Visibility Architect) rather than re-explaining it, testing their combined application instead.

questions.q: What does this lesson deliberately avoid stating as fixed fact, and why?
options: The exact current question count, time limit, and passing score, because these exam mechanics change between exam versions and this course would risk stating outdated or unverified figures as current fact
The names of the four prerequisite certifications
The general competency areas the credential assesses
The URL of Salesforce's official credential page
questions.explain: The lesson explicitly withholds specific exam-format numbers because they change and could become stale, directing students instead to Salesforce's own official, current exam guide.

questions.q: Where does this lesson direct students to find current, reliable exam format details?
options: A third-party blog with no official affiliation
This course's quiz.json files
A random internet search with no specific source named
Salesforce's own Architect credentials page and official exam guide, specifically trailhead.salesforce.com/credentials/applicationarchitect
questions.explain: The lesson names Salesforce's own official credential page and exam guide as the reliable, current source for exam mechanics, since Salesforce maintains it directly.

questions.q: According to this lesson, what does Salesforce's own credential material say Application Architects have particular strength in?
options: Writing the fastest possible Apex triggers
Modeling a role hierarchy, data, and the appropriate sharing mechanisms for a given business scenario
Designing marketing email campaigns
Managing Salesforce billing and license procurement
questions.explain: The lesson cites Salesforce's own description of Application Architects as having deep platform understanding and particular strength in modeling a role hierarchy, data, and sharing mechanisms.

questions.q: Why does this lesson say this course alone is not a sufficient study plan for the actual certification exam?
options: Because this course covers no exam-relevant material at all
Because only Salesforce employees are allowed to take the exam

Because a realistic study plan also needs genuinely held prerequisite certifications, hands-on practice in a Developer Edition or scratch org, and Salesforce's own current official exam guide -- not just one input
Because this course is only relevant to the Technical Architect credential
questions.explain: The lesson explicitly frames itself as one input among several needed for a realistic study plan: genuine prerequisite mastery, hands-on practice, and the official exam guide all matter alongside this course's judgment-focused content.
